notes: SHIP v1.14.435 - M2-b STAGES 3a AND 3b: THE FLAT PATH, DEMOTION, AND THE DOOR (RACKENGINE-SPEC sections 2, 4, 5). WHY THEY SHIPPED TOGETHER. Section 4 has TWO axes - mode chooses the rig and which controls render, interactive chooses WebGL versus flat - and the engine had no flat path at all. That is why map, review and hero, all interactive:false by spec, were unrepresentable, and why section 5 demote could not exist: there was nowhere to demote TO. attach is only honest once a flat path exists, because its headline guarantee is idempotency and an idempotent attach with no way to refresh the handle returns a stale scene. So they are one ship. WHAT IS BACKED. Flat rendering with NO GL context, absorbing the cmd_rackHeroFlat pattern and fed by the stage-1 resolver. Demotion that disposes the context but KEEPS the surface rendering and keeps the attachment in the census, so report() never loses a rack that is still on screen. Promotion that re-acquires through the reclaim barrier using the reacquire callback v1.14.427 already added - stage 2 and the .427 hand-back are what made promote implementable at all. attach idempotency per host: attaching to a host that already carries an attachment for the SAME rackId returns the existing handle and applies changed params without rebuilding. update on a FLAT attachment re-renders and allocates nothing, which is I2 held for real. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT BACKED, AND IS ASSERTED AS A REFUSAL SO THE DAY IT BECOMES REAL THE TEST SAYS SO. View-state preservation across demote: section 5 says a demoted attachment keeps camera, explode and cable state and restores them on promote, but the camera lives INSIDE the scene that dispose tears down and capturing it needs renderer cooperation, which is stage 3d. Promote today re-acquires with a fresh camera - recorded rather than claimed. update on an INTERACTIVE attachment: neither renderer can mutate in place, both build wholesale, so it returns false and says so rather than silently rebuilding, which would break I2 while appearing to honour it. Interactive creation through attach: the engine cannot BUILD a GL scene yet, so attach refuses loudly rather than returning a handle to a surface nobody rendered. ALSO IN THIS SHIP. register gained an optional rackId - additive, omitting callers keep working - and attachments now carry rackId, mode and interactive. report() surfaces all three: section 10 census could previously say neither WHICH rack a surface was showing nor whether it held a context. Additive, every existing reader takes host/kind/paused/connected and is unaffected. Demotion arms the reclaim barrier like any other release, so I6 holds on this path too. TESTS: new spec 24-flat-path-and-attach, eight tests - flat renders with zero canvases and zero contexts (I7), attach creates a flat attachment and the census reports rack and mode, attach is idempotent with an identity witness proving the attachment was not rebuilt, update on flat allocates nothing, demotion keeps the surface and the census entry and arms the barrier, promote defers through the barrier rather than acquiring in the same task, promote with no reacquire refuses VISIBLY per section 9, and the three refusals above. 24: 8 passed. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, CSS braces balanced, CRLF intact, three-stamp lockstep. No UI surface changed, no CSS changed. ?legacy=1 unaffected. DEVICE-VERIFY: none required - nothing an operator can reach changed. ⛔ RENDERER CONSOLIDATION STOPS HERE BY OWNER DIRECTIVE. Stage 3c, 3d and the section 8 deletions are NOT started and are not the technician-facing priority.
